name: 時間帯を示すメッセージ予約送信
prompt:
Create a faithful static Japanese Slack schedule-message sheet, matching the exact original source crop for modal geometry and source colors, and the native Japanese preview for the Japanese copy and 390×472 target.

Recreate only the rounded-top white sheet, from its short centered gray drag handle down to the green confirmation button. No dimmed background, status bar, phone chrome, home indicator, footer or branding.

At the top, bold title 「送信日時を予約」 and smaller gray subtitle 「時刻は日本標準時です」. After the source divider, show the plain dark option 「月曜日の9:00」, then a divider and plain dark 「日時を指定」. Below that, a four-column wheel with these five rows:
「5月30日(木)」 | 10 | 58 | 午前
「昨日」 | 11 | 59 | 午前
selected center row 「6月1日(土)」 | 12 | 00 | 午後
「6月2日(日)」 | 1 | 01 | 午後
「6月3日(月)」 | 2 | 02 | 午後
Use the original screenshot's wide rounded neutral-gray selection band, not the mint preview highlight. Make selected values bold near-black; adjacent rows gray and softly faded.

At the bottom, place one full-width rounded Slack-green button with exact white label 「送信を予約」. Match the original source button's flat green fill and dimensions. Keep modal text dark or white on the button; there are no hyperlinks in this component and no blue text should appear.

The full source time-wheel selected value differs from the Japanese native preview. Preserve Japanese preview values and Japan Standard Time wording, while using the original screenshot for geometry, row spacing, neutral-gray selection, and button treatment. Static image only; do not imply wheel animation.
reviewNotes: Exact Japanese copy and neutral-gray selected band are preserved. No hyperlink text appears. The title/options and lower wheel spacing remain oversized or loose, and the green button has visible gradient/texture.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
